title: Chordbreaker Penitent
text: Chordbreaker Penitent beats a cracked tuning bar against its armor and charges at every discordant sound. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Silence is the only absolution it accepts.

defeatReward.text: Chordbreaker Penitent is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
